subject: [PATCH 2/3] mm/page_alloc: drop the pcp lock before enabling IRQs after a refill

2026-11-25.patch_summary: This patch addresses a performance issue in the Linux kernel's page allocation code by dropping the per-cpu page list (pcp) lock before enabling interrupts after refilling an empty pcp list. This is necessary because, when IRQs are disabled, an interrupt can occur while the pcp lock is held, causing softirqs to take the zone lock for each page. The patch improves performance in a 128-vCPU guest by reducing contention on the zone lock and shortening callback duration.
